page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m4.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.u2a server family. It is built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an x86_64 architecture AMD EPYC processor. The instance features 4 dedicated vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz, paired with 16.0 GB of system memory, which provides a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance configuration does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. It lacks integrated GPU hardware accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The ecs.u2a-c1m4.xlarge offers a balanced resource profile suitable for standard enterprise workloads. Its dedicated AMD EPYC CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core instances. This resource density makes it a cost-efficient option for general-purpose applications, such as medium-traffic web servers, application servers, development environments, and microservices that require a stable 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio.
